features.notes: Snipo has a privacy policy stating they don't sell user data to third parties. Extension data is transferred and stored securely, uses IP anonymization for analytics, and allows contact at privacy@snipo.io for data questions. However, lacks end-to-end encryption details and offline-first approach.

Snipo is described as easy to use and accessible from any device with internet connection. Endorsed by over 10,000 users and trusted by companies like IBM, Intel, Samsung, Harvard, and Stanford. Browser extension works across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Brave.

Snipo is designed as a low-maintenance solution that seamlessly fits into YouTube and Notion layouts. As a browser extension, it requires minimal setup and maintenance from users, with automatic integration into supported learning platforms.

Snipo operates on a freemium model with free YouTube access and premium features for other platforms. Heavily dependent on Notion integration and third-party learning platforms. No evidence of open-source code or self-hosting options. Long-term sustainability unclear due to lack of funding/business model transparency.

Snipo requires internet connection to function as it's a browser extension that integrates with online platforms (YouTube, Udemy, etc.) and syncs data to Notion. No offline functionality available for taking or accessing notes without internet.

Snipo specializes in video note-taking with timestamped notes, screenshot capture from videos, transcript access, and support for YouTube, Udemy, Coursera, Skillshare, and LinkedIn Learning. Supports playlists and courses syncing.
Supports taking timestamped notes while watching videos and provides access to video transcripts for easy reference.
Can capture screenshots of charts, graphs, or slides from videos during note-taking.
Supports custom decks for organizing AI flashcards and playlist/course organization.

Snipo provides organizational features through Notion integration, including course/playlist indexing and notebook organization. However, no dedicated search functionality within the extension itself - search capabilities depend on Notion's search features.
AI flashcards are auto-generated from learning videos and webpages, suggesting some semantic understanding capabilities.
Integrates with Notion for exporting notes and supports Anki export for flashcards, indicating some API or integration capabilities.
